mod.name: Train Up
dummy.name: Training Dummy
dummy.description: A sturdy straw dummy. Whack it with a weapon to practice and earn Combat XP.
config.enabled.name: Enable mod

config.perks.name: Enable profession perks
config.perks.tooltip: Apply the stat and gameplay bonuses from chosen professions.
config.debug.name: Debug logging
config.debug.tooltip: Log each XP award to the SMAPI console (Trace level).
config.defense-rate.name: Defense XP per damage

config.vitality-rate.name: Vitality XP per HP lost

config.stamina-rate.name: Stamina XP per energy
config.stamina-rate.tooltip: Stamina XP earned per point of energy spent. 0 disables Stamina training.
config.caps.paragraph: Limit how much XP each skill can earn per day. Set to 0 for no limit.

config.vitality-cap.name: Vitality daily cap

config.perlevel.paragraph: Passive stat bonus each skill grants per level, on top of professions. Set to 0 to disable.
config.vitality-perlevel.name: Max HP per Vitality level
config.stamina-perlevel.name: Max energy per Stamina level
config.defense-perlevel.name: Defense per Defense level
